site.name: Cybersecurity Club
site.tagline: Learn, Connect, and Grow in the Field of Cybersecurity
site.description: A ready-to-customize website template for cybersecurity clubs, student organizations, and community security groups.

membership.eligibility: Open to all students and community members interested in cybersecurity.

home.intro: Our club is dedicated to providing resources, events, and a community for individuals interested in cybersecurity. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced professional, you'll find valuable information and opportunities to enhance your skills and knowledge.

about.mission: Our mission is to educate and empower individuals with the knowledge and skills necessary to protect themselves and others in the digital world.
about.overview: We offer resources, events, and opportunities for members to learn about cybersecurity, network with professionals, and participate in hands-on activities.
goals: Promote awareness and understanding of cybersecurity issues.
Provide training and resources to develop cybersecurity skills.
Foster a community of cybersecurity enthusiasts and professionals.
about.team: Our team is made up of dedicated professionals and enthusiasts who are passionate about cybersecurity.

join.intro: Become a member to access club resources, participate in events, and join a community of cybersecurity learners.
